prompts.hero: Create a new single high resolution full-body celebratory hero illustration using exactly the GREEN DRAGON character in the supplied reference sprite sheet. Reference is character identity only, not a sheet to reproduce. Preserve leaf-green body, cream rounded muzzle and belly, yellow rounded dorsal spikes, pie-cut black eyes, rosy cheeks, cream gloves, oversized cream shoes, friendly short chubby proportions and long green tail. Pose: proudly standing in three-quarter view toward the right, hands on hips, chest puffed out, very happy confident open smile, eyes open. A lovable triumphant cartoon actor taking a bow after winning. 1930s rubber-hose cel animation drawing with strong irregular dark ink contour and subtle hand painted shading, same visual family as reference. One character only, completely visible from spikes to feet, tight portrait composition with small transparent margins. Genuine transparent background. No text, no scenery, no trophy, no other characters, no border, no spotlight, no ground shadow baked into a background. This is production game victory-screen hero art, not gameplay pixel art.
prompts.scoreboard: Use case illustration-story. Production game UI asset: one LARGE BLANK VINTAGE CARTOON SCOREBOARD, no lettering anywhere. Front view, slightly wider than tall (about 1.15 width to 1 height). Hand-inked 1930s theatrical award plaque silhouette: flat short top edge with clipped shoulders, sides bow outward gently, generous rounded bowl-shaped bottom. A thick uneven warm ivory and muted gold frame with dark hand-inked contour surrounds a deep near-black charcoal chalkboard interior with very subtle paper/grain texture. A broad blank flowing cream ribbon curls across the lower edge, with rolled tails at each side and strong dark ink contours, gold warm undersides. Its middle is a wide clear empty area for our own UI text. Inner black area must be huge and clean, from 15 percent down to 75 percent of total height, so five large rows of actual UI text will fit. No decorative markings inside. Elegant, playful, slightly imperfect hand-drawn craftsmanship, visually substantial rim. Entire plaque visible with small transparent margins. Actual transparent background outside the frame, including outside ribbon tails. No text, no numbers, no stars, no characters, no scenery.
prompts.backdrop: Use case illustration-story. Production full-screen game results BACKGROUND ONLY, no objects or lettering. Wide 16:9 theatrical blue sunburst field in a 1930s hand-painted cartoon film style. Luminous pale icy blue and desaturated turquoise light radiates from the center behind the actors, deep ocean blue and navy at the corners. About 16 broad irregular softly painted radial rays, with cloudy soft light between them, never mechanically straight uniform vector wedges. Rich watercolor/gouache surface, subtle aged film grain and gentle mottling, slightly dark vignette at edges. Cheerful triumphant theatrical mood, high quality vintage animation background. Keep the center fairly calm so a character and scoreboard will read clearly. No text, no characters, no objects, no frames, no UI, no logos, no stars or confetti.
prompts.title: Use case illustration-story. Production game UI lettering asset. Exact text: "THE RESULTS!" in ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL LINE. Huge exuberant hand-lettered 1930s rubber-hose cartoon capitals, warm golden yellow faces, orange hand-painted shading at lower strokes, thick very dark navy/black ink outline and dramatic chunky offset black drop shadow downward to the right. Each letter has its own playful tilt and width, expressive uneven baseline but exceptional readability. Exclamation mark big and emphatic. Overall word silhouette should be about 5.5 times wider than tall, broad and sweeping. Fill a wide canvas, tight transparent bounds around lettering with only modest transparent margins. No extra words, no characters, no scenery, no rectangular panel or ribbon. Actual transparent background, no glow outside the shadow. A premium illustrated title for a theatrical victory results screen.
